cover_letter:
Dear Hiring Team,

I'm writing to apply for the Sales & Client Relationship Manager position. With a background in digital marketing and hands-on client work, I'm drawn to a role that blends closing deals with maintaining strong client relationships.

In my current role at Episto, I handle on-page SEO, keyword research, and content for client websites, tracking results with Semrush, Ahrefs, Google Analytics, and Search Console. I also manage CMS content in WordPress, ensuring pages and blog posts are published and updated as promised. This experience has taught me the importance of clear communication and follow-through—key for a single point of contact role.

As a freelancer, I've built and optimized websites for clients like mirook.com and majistraleczacilari.org.tr, where I implemented technical SEO and structured data. I've also worked on Shopify stores, managing product catalogues and blog content. These projects required me to understand client needs, coordinate timelines, and deliver results that aligned with expectations.

I'm comfortable with cold outreach and follow-ups, and I'm eager to support outbound campaigns. I use Google Workspace and Microsoft Office daily for reporting and admin tasks, and I'm fluent in English. I'm available to work five days a week, including Saturday half days, and can be available for emergencies when required.

While I haven't worked in a pure sales role, my client-facing experience and problem-solving mindset have prepared me to close deals and handle objections. I'm a quick learner and ready to take on administrative tasks like invoicing and contract preparation.

I'd welcome the opportunity to discuss how my skills can contribute to your team.

Sincerely,
Baver Ok
